name: Assay desk
description: The Assay desk helps a screening lab read its plate-reader exports. It works only from the lab's own files: its plates, each instrument's export, the well map and the lab's policy. It normalizes wells to percent inhibition against the plate's own controls, works out a plate's Z′ and whether it passes, calls hits by the lab's rule, judges replicates, and queues re-tests for failed plates and borderline or inconclusive compounds. It only writes to retests.csv.
summary: Reads a screening lab's plate exports by the lab's own rules.
does: Normalizes wells to percent inhibition against the plate’s controls
Works out Z′ and passes or fails a plate
Calls hits and judges replicates by the lab's rule
Queues re-tests the policy calls for
doesNot: Never calls hits on a plate that fails QC
Asks before it adds to the re-test queue

taskTypes.label: Normalize
taskTypes.description: Percent inhibition of named wells, against the plate’s own controls.

taskTypes.label: Hits
taskTypes.description: A plate's hits by the lab's rule.

taskTypes.label: Plate QC
taskTypes.description: A plate's Z′, and whether it passes.

taskTypes.label: Replicates
taskTypes.description: Whether a compound's wells agree, and its call.

taskTypes.label: Re-test plan
taskTypes.description: Queue the re-tests the policy calls for.

taskTypes.label: Plate report
taskTypes.description: The whole read of a plate: QC, hits and re-tests.

files.name: policy.md
files.description: The lab's rules for reading a plate, in its own words: its controls, percent inhibition, the Z′ a plate needs to pass, the hit rule, replicates, borderline compounds and how to queue re-tests, with the lab's numbers and reason codes.

files.name: plates.csv
files.description: Every plate the lab read: plate_id, layout (96 or 384 wells), instrument, read_on, and export_file, the export that holds its wells.

files.name: compounds.csv
files.description: The well map: for each well of each plate, the compound in it, or the policy's code for a control well, and its concentration in µM.

files.name: lumen_export.csv
files.description: The Lumen 3 plate reader's export: Plate ID, Well, Counts, one row per well, for every plate read on it. A lab without the instrument has no such file.

files.name: kestrel_export.csv
files.description: The Kestrel HT plate reader's export: Barcode, Row, Col, RFU, one row per well, for every plate read on it. A lab without the instrument has no such file.

files.name: orbit_export.csv
files.description: The Orbit 2 plate reader's export: Plate, Well Position, Raw Signal, one row per well, for every plate read on it. A lab without the instrument has no such file.

files.name: retests.csv
files.description: The re-test queue: whole plates and single compounds to run again. New requests go here.
